ruleset.name: NoFormatterDirectivesCustomDirectives
ruleset.description: Configures NoFormatterDirectives the way a consuming project's ruleset does — a real <property type="array"> holding <element> nodes, parsed by PHPCS's own ruleset reader. The sniff is referenced by file path so the standard needs no installed_paths entry; PHPCS still derives the CleanCode.CodeStyle.NoFormatterDirectives code from that path.
